probes.directive: // @ts-expect-error negative: publication-missing-producer. Every publication requires the complete producer.
probes.statement: createViewPublication({ owner: ports.owner, tabs: ports.tabs, monitor: ports.monitor, privateSkips: ports.privateSkips, clock: ports.clock })

probes.directive: // @ts-expect-error negative: publication-partial-producer. A scope does not supply a complete TabView.
// @ts-expect-error negative: publication-missing-validator. Delivery requires the concrete validator.
// @ts-expect-error negative: publication-invented-target. Window broadcasts are outside the target vocabulary.
// @ts-expect-error negative: publication-fake-account. Raw identities require account validation.
// @ts-expect-error negative: publication-privacy-mixing. A scope is one explicit target variant.
// @ts-expect-error negative: publication-fabricated-handle. Tabs alone creates the nominal live-core identity.
probes.statement: ports.tabs.publish({ tabId: 1, acct, privateTab: false }, ports.producer, new AbortController().signal, () => true)

probes.directive: // @ts-expect-error negative: publication-disposed-handle. Disposal returns no live target handle.
// @ts-expect-error negative: publication-monitor-required. No healthy or empty-notice fallback exists.
probes.statement: createViewPublication({ owner: ports.owner, tabs: ports.tabs, privateSkips: ports.privateSkips, producer: ports.producer, clock: ports.clock })

probes.directive: // @ts-expect-error negative: publication-private-storage-event. The canonical session owner cannot confirm private memory.
probes.statement: const privateStorage: ConfirmedViewChange = { kind: "skips-changed", acct, scope: "private" }

probes.directive: // @ts-expect-error negative: tabs-target-account-required. Account targets carry a validated account.
// @ts-expect-error negative: tabs-target-not-requester. A UI requester cannot select publication targets.
// @ts-expect-error negative: tabs-target-opaque. A numeric tab ID cannot replace a live handle.
// @ts-expect-error negative: tabs-publish-cancellation. A target delivery needs its lifetime signal.
// @ts-expect-error negative: monitor-view-not-generic. Projected changes identify the affected tab.
// @ts-expect-error negative: owner-view-no-fake-account. Confirmed view events retain branded account identities.
// @ts-expect-error negative: owner-view-no-cache-event. Cache bookkeeping cannot become a confirmed view change.
// @ts-expect-error negative: publication-private-source-required. Private changes require the actual AddFlow subscription.
probes.statement: createViewPublication({ owner: ports.owner, tabs: ports.tabs, monitor: ports.monitor, producer: ports.producer, clock: ports.clock })

probes.directive: // @ts-expect-error negative: add-flow-private-scope. Private memory never emits normal session events.
probes.statement: flow.subscribePrivateSkips((event: { acct: AccountKey; scope: "normal" }) => { void event })
